environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application running in a Docker container based on mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0 with default capabilities. Container runs as root with --privileged flag for legacy compatibility. Host network mode enabled. No seccomp profile applied. Container runtime is Docker 24.0 with default AppArmor profile disabled (--security-opt apparmor=unconfined).
